messages:
Maya K: Heads up — ArkBridge EAP hardware soak starts TOMORROW 09:00 PT. NDA is signed, partner has lab access. Need final bench plan, telemetry endpoints, and an ops runbook for the 72h soak.

Oscar R: Got it. I'll draft the bench plan today. Quick Q — do we want to run perf-only or perf+stability (mem/thermal) sweeps?

Maya K: perf+stability. Focus windows: 0–30k tokens/session (latency) and long sessions for KV cache retention. Thermal telemetry is a must.

Lin Z: Proposed targets: p95 < 120ms for small-chat profile, sustained 6000 tokens/s across the pool with <=2% error rate. If we can't hit both, prioritize p95.

Andre (Partner Ops): ArkBridge can expose metrics to our telemetry endpoint. Need the exact URL and token format. Also, who owns test user data (we assume partner synthetic only)?

Maya K: Yes — partner will use synthetic data only. Telemetry endpoint: https://telemetry.redwood-inference.com/ingest/arkbridge-eap
Auth: bearer token — I'll DM the token to ArkBridge and ops.

arkbridge-eng: Thanks — we will enable agent v0.9.3. Do you have a sample config for the agent?

Oscar R: Sample config (use in agent):
```yaml
metrics:
  endpoint: https://telemetry.redwood-inference.com/ingest/arkbridge-eap
  auth: Bearer $REDACTED
  interval: 10s
profiles:
  - name: small-chat
    seq_len: 32
    qps: 2500
  - name: long-session
    seq_len: 4096
    qps: 100
```

Lin Z: We'll also dump kernel-level traces for the first 6 hours (low-overhead) and full trace if errors >1% in a 1h window. Tag traces with run_id and image_sha.

Andre (Partner Ops): Schedule wise — can we do a brief sync 08:30 PT tomorrow to validate access and keys?

Maya K: Yes, 08:30 PT sync works. Invite sent to arkbridge-eng. Agenda: verify S3 buckets, telemetry ingestion, and canary run (10 minutes).

arkbridge-eng: Confirmed. We'll provision GPUs tonight and run pre-checks. Can you share S3 path for artifacts and the minimum retention?

Oscar R: Upload artifacts to s3://redwood-eap/arkbridge/<run_id>/artifacts. Retention: 14 days by default, 90 days if we flag for deeper analysis.

Maya K: Note for Marketplace/PR team — DO NOT publicize this EAP. This is NDA-only, no joint announcement until we pass acceptance criteria and sign the comms plan. @Andre (Partner Ops) to own comms gating.

Andre (Partner Ops): On it. I'll draft the comms gating checklist during the soak: 1) pass perf SLA, 2) no P0s, 3) telemetry healthy for 72h, 4) partner security review complete.

Lin Z: Failure modes + actionables:
- If p95 > 200ms for >30m -> auto-scale down test and notify eng-oncall.
- If error rate >5% for 1h -> abort soak and collect full traces.
- If thermal thresholds exceeded -> reduce concurrency and notify partner ops.

Maya K: Add fallback model routing in the canary config so we don't blow up downstream customers if something leaks. Use model fallback: redwood/small-chat-v1 -> redwood/small-chat-compat-v0.9.

arkbridge-eng: One ask — can we get a short list of perf scripts or harnesses you run so results are comparable to your hosted runs?

Oscar R: We'll share the harness repo link in the sync. TL;DR: same prompt mixes as hosted benchmark, randomized user pacing, and KV cache warmup sequences.

deploy-bot: deploy-request: perf/harness v2.3 queued for staging, run_id=arkbridge-soak-3120004321, ETA 30m.

Maya K: Great — team, please ensure we capture these in the soak playbook: run_id, tags, expected SLOs, rollback criteria, and comms channel (#partnerships). I'll post the final bench plan by 18:00 PT today.

Oscar R: I'll finish the bench plan and ping the group when uploaded.

arkbridge-eng: Thanks all — see you on the 08:30 sync. We'll attach our lab contact and BMC access in the invite. :white_check_mark:

Maya K: Thanks — closing loop here. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: once you've reviewed the playbook after I post it.
